_meta.description: Published premium quotes used to validate src/premium.py. Annual premiums in local currency. Only type 'published' quotes are used for fitting and accuracy scores; 'derived' quotes apply official rating factors to a published figure, so they are not independent and are shown for illustration only.
_meta.standard_life: Unless stated, adults are BMI 24, non-smoking, with no pre-existing disease (insurer 'standard life').

USA.label: Age 40, non-smoker, individual (benchmark silver)
USA.source: KFF, Average Monthly Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier, 2026: US average benchmark silver for a 40-year-old = $625/month

USA.label: Age 30, non-smoker, individual
USA.source: KFF $625/month (age 40) x CMS federal default age curve 1.135/1.278 = $555.07/month

USA.label: Age 45, smoker, individual
USA.source: KFF $625/month x CMS age curve 1.444/1.278 x federal max tobacco ratio 1.5 (45 CFR 147.102) = $1,059.29/month

USA.label: Family: two adults 35, children 5 and 8
USA.source: KFF $625/month x CMS age curve (2 x 1.222 + 2 x 0.765) / 1.278 = $1,943.47/month

USA.label: Employer plan, single coverage (average covered worker)
USA.source: KFF 2026 Employer Health Benefits Survey (pub. 22 Oct 2026, 1,937 firms): average annual premium, single coverage, $9,804 (employer + worker share)

USA.label: Employer plan, family of four
USA.source: KFF 2026 Employer Health Benefits Survey: average annual premium, family coverage (defined as a family of four), $28,303
